name: Scalable Volume Rendering via Weighted Sum
definition: An interactive technique that offers a continuous transition between different reconstructions (specifically between approximating and prefiltered interpolating cubic B-splines) controlled by a single parameter. It avoids computing two expensive filters by using the same filter on two different data sets.
summary: Scalable Volume Rendering via Weighted Sum is an interactive technique that bridges approximating and interpolating filters using a single parameter, achieving high performance by applying one kernel to both original and prefiltered data simultaneously.
